nf:register.nf:name: dmem_in_lo
nf:register.nf:description: SW reg 0x1: DMEM write data [31:0] (with dmem_in_hi on dmem write)

nf:register.nf:name: imem
nf:register.nf:description: SW reg 0x2: IMEM write data register

nf:register.nf:name: address
nf:register.nf:description: SW reg 0x3: [8:0] IMEM addr, [7:0] DMEM byte addr, [15:8] GPU length for SW start

nf:register.nf:name: input_type
nf:register.nf:description: SW reg 0x4 control bits: bit0 IMEM write, bit1 DMEM write, bit2 DMEM read, bit3 SW gpu_start pulse, bit4 IMEM read

nf:register.nf:name: cpu_ctrl
nf:register.nf:description: SW reg 0x5 CPU control; write bit0 0->1 to pulse ARM cpu_start (bits[31:1] reserved)

nf:register.nf:name: dmem_out_lo
nf:register.nf:description: DMEM read data [31:0] (64b line with dmem_out_hi)

nf:register.nf:name: tensor_out
nf:register.nf:description: Captured tensor result from EX stage
